module: Counter of the triangles actually drawn by a "kit" (instanced pieces), as seen from the camera: each instance is counted at the LOD it really draws, minus those off screen. Used by the statsFooter footer. Keeps a single answer at a time (the editor has only one edit mode). The measured LOD scales, which are costly, are shared and cached on disk in /temp/massingEditor/shapeLods.json (with the shape file's modification date).
usage:
local tl = require('editor/toolUtilities/triLive')
tl.note(instances)     -- on every rebuild
tl.scanStep()          -- every frame
tl.update(instances)
local tris, dist, live, placed, toScan = tl.get()
notes: Each instance must have shape (shape path), px, py, pz.
Update limited to 4 Hz, and 10000 instances processed per frame so as not to freeze the editor on a large city.
The computation assumes an engine constant ENGINE_SCALE = 4.48 measured at 1920x1009 and 65 degrees, with the real FOV and window size. Visibility is tested by a cone around the screen diagonal.
A shape that cannot be measured is counted as drawing nothing for the session, with a logged warning, and retried at the next reload.
A shape whose file has been rewritten since the measurement is measured again.

note.desc: Queues the shapes of `instances` never measured (or whose file has changed). Cheap enough to be called on every rebuild.

instances.desc: List of entries with a shape field.

scanStep.desc: Measures ONE shape per call (LOD scale), called from the editor frame so that the cold scan shows up as progress rather than a freeze. Saves the cache when the queue is empty.

returns.desc: True if a shape was processed.

update.desc: Computes the total of instanced triangles on screen and the camera - instance centroid distance. Rate-limited and split into slices of 10000 instances per frame.

instances.desc: List of entries { shape, px, py, pz }.

get.desc: Last result: instanced triangles drawn, distance to the instances' centroid (m), instances drawn, instances placed, shapes left to scan.

rescan.desc: Clears the measurement cache, the scales, the queue and the failures: "retry everything". The cache will be rewritten.
